title: Two Italian workers killed in drone attack in Kuwait, Iran denies role
caption:
Two Italian technicians working for Rheinmetall were killed when drones targeted a military site in Kuwait on Thursday, Kuwait's army says. Kuwait and Italy say the drones were Iranian; Iran denies any involvement and has proposed a joint investigation. It is the first deadly strike in Kuwait in months, as tensions in the Gulf rise again.
